_comment: 12 gate-checkable JS tickets for the K2.5(.said) vs Composer-2.5 paired test. Each: a stubbed src file + a node test gate that is RED until the function is implemented. 6 recurring (same shape: implement one pure function to spec) + 6 novel (varied shapes). Gate = `node test/<id>.test.js` exits 0.

tickets.task: Implement add(a, b) in src/r1.js to return the sum of two numbers.
Implement max(arr) in src/r2.js to return the largest number in a non-empty array.
Implement reverse(s) in src/r3.js to return the input string reversed.
Implement isEven(n) in src/r4.js to return true if n is an even integer, else false.
Implement sum(arr) in src/r5.js to return the sum of all numbers in the array (0 for empty).
Implement countVowels(s) in src/r6.js to return the number of vowels (a,e,i,o,u, case-insensitive) in the string.
Implement fib(n) in src/n1.js returning the nth Fibonacci number (fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1).
Implement isPalindrome(s) in src/n2.js: true if s reads the same forwards and backwards ignoring case and non-alphanumeric chars.
Implement romanToInt(s) in src/n3.js converting a Roman numeral string (I,V,X,L,C,D,M) to its integer value.
Implement groupBy(arr, keyFn) in src/n4.js returning an object mapping each keyFn(item) to the array of items with that key, preserving order.

Implement debounceCount(events, windowMs) in src/n5.js: given an array of {t} timestamps (ms, ascending), return how many events remain after collapsing any event within windowMs of the previously KEPT event (the first is always kept).

Implement parseQuery(qs) in src/n6.js parsing a URL query string like 'a=1&b=two&a=3' into an object; repeated keys become an array in order: {a:['1','3'], b:'two'}. Leading '?' is optional. Empty string -> {}.
